ernie: Noticing Orchid20b (int4, gptq) canary started to OOM on long chat sessions after the allocator alignment change + new prefetch heuristic. Error burst ~8% on canary pods. Repro log below.

tara: Can you paste the log and config?

ernie: Sure. Snippet: 
```
# /var/log/inference/orchid-canary.log
[2026-05-03T11:22:10Z] ERROR oom: gpu_alloc failed 62914560 bytes at gpu_pool.cc:97
[2026-05-03T11:22:10Z] INFO seq_len=1420 prefetch_slots=30 kv_cache=1.1GB post_frag=0.70
[2026-05-03T11:22:10Z] INFO serving-config: max_new_tokens=384 batch_size=6 prefetch=aggressive alloc_align=256 quant=gptq-v3
```

min: Quick local stress (25k mixed requests):
- canary config: OOM_rate 8.6% for seq>1200, p95 480ms
- tweak1: max_new_tokens=128, batch_size=3, prefetch=moderate => OOM_rate 1.0%, p95 520ms
- tweak2: tweak1 + compactor.interval=60s + kv_trim_threshold=0.56 + soft_reserve=1.0GB => OOM_rate 0.2%, p95 540ms

tara: Looks like the usual pattern: alignment change increased fragmentation under aggressive prefetch. I prefer a model-level safe profile rather than reverting allocator globally.

ernie: Agreed. Proposed orchid profile:
- model.profile.max_new_tokens = "128"
- model.profile.max_batch_size = "3"
- model.profile.prefetch = "moderate"
- runtime.kv_trim_threshold = "0.56"
- compactor.interval = "60s"
- runtime.soft_reserve = "1.0GB"
- runtime.alloc_align = "512"  # pod-level override to reduce fragmentation
- fallback.variant = "orchid20b-int8" when session_len > 850 or oom_rate > 1.5%
- pod.kernel_fallback = "alloc-align-256" if alloc_failures > 4% in 10m

perf-bot: Queued Redwood Optimize eval: convo-mix (50/50 short/long), deterministic seeds, compare int4 profile vs int8 & fp16. ETA ~1.5h.

ops-bot: @ernie canary-config "orchid20b: safe-align-profile" applied to canary pool (10% traffic) at 3234567920 by ops-bot :wrench:

min: I'll instrument per-pod memfrag histograms and kernel alloc failures on the perf dashboard. Also adding an alert: canary oom_rate > 2% over 10m => auto-rollback.

qa: Add a quality-block: if ROUGE-L drops >1% vs fp16 in eval, block auto-promotion. We need to watch small quality regressions for certain prompts.

ernie: Good call. Also include short runbook steps: how to force int8 fallback for single pool, how to read memfrag waterfall, and emergency rollback commands. I'll draft the PR.

perf-bot: (later) Eval results: int4 + safe-align-profile: OOM_rate 0.3% (down from 8.6%), ROUGE-L delta vs fp16 = -0.15%, avg latency +6%. int8 fallback: OOM_rate 0%, ROUGE-L delta = -1.0%, latency +3%. Recommendation: keep int4 with conservative profile and auto-fallback to int8 when session_len>850 or oom alert trips.

mina: Minor tweak suggestion: set compactor.slab_defrag = "true" for this model to reduce external fragmentation further. Small CPU cost but helps long sessions.

ernie: Add that to PR. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/infra/patches/4120 - contains profile, compactor slab_defrag, dashboard panels, and runbook. Merging after 1h if green.

ops-bot: PR 4120 CI: green.

tara: No objections. Merge on green and promote: 10% -> 30% after 30m stable -> 70% after 2h stable. Auto-rollback thresholds: oom_rate > 1.5% or quality drift > 0.8% ROUGE-L.

ernie: Thanks all. Will update onboarding docs and release notes. :rocket:
